---
title: "Stata help file"
description: >
  The help file of the Stata command, as displayed by `help powerape`.
---

```{r helpers, include = FALSE}
root <- normalizePath(getwd(), winslash = "/")
while (!file.exists(file.path(root, "DESCRIPTION")) && dirname(root) != root)
  root <- dirname(root)
source(file.path(root, "precompute", "helpers.R"))
```

This is the help file that `help powerape` opens in Stata, converted to
plain text. For a guided introduction see
[Get started in Stata](stata.html); for the corresponding R functions see
[R and Stata side by side](r-and-stata.html).

```{r, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
f <- file.path(.pc_dir(), "stata", "output", "powerape-help.txt")
txt <- readLines(f, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")

# Drop the Stata logo above the title and the common left margin.
txt <- txt[grep("^\\s*Title\\s*$", txt)[1]:length(txt)]
txt <- sub("\\s+$", "", txt)
margin <- min(nchar(sub("^( *).*$", "\\1", txt[nzchar(txt)])))
txt <- substring(txt, margin + 1)
# at most one blank line in a row
blank <- !nzchar(txt)
txt <- txt[!(blank & c(FALSE, head(blank, -1)))]

cat("```{.stata-help}", txt, "```", sep = "\n")
```
